preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the polygon must be between 3 and 100,000.
The needed angle must be between 1 and 180 degrees.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= v1 <= n and 1 <= v2 <= n and 1 <= v3 <= n
postconditions.description: The vertices v1, v2, and v3 must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: v1 != v2 and v2 != v3 and v1 != v3
postconditions.description: The vertices v1, v2, and v3 must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: abs(angle(v1, v2, v3) - a) == min(abs(angle(i, j, k) - a) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for k in range(1, n+1) if i != j and j != k and i != k)
postconditions.description: The angle formed by vertices v1, v2, and v3 must be as close as possible to the given angle a.
